nodes.title: OPEN (understanding phase): a right answer to her own TEACHING question earns no evidence. Sim lab ok10x on b7413e5f, 3 of 4 runs: after an explain move ending 'what do we call one of the 5 parts?', the child's correct '2/5 … do gaps aage jaana padega, na?' had no card on the table (ui.ask empty, target mode none), so it was ungraded by design. That is the same rule as worked-example steps and QA's '130 metre'. To count such answers, the Director would have to pose the card itself after the explanation, or grade a teaching question against a verified key. That is design, not a grader fix. Decide in the understanding phase, with the covert-understanding read. Reverse or close when that phase rules on which of her questions are evidence.

md.decisions:
## open-r1441-teaching-question-unread — her teaching questions are not evidence (open, 2026-10-21)

When she ends an explanation on a question and the child answers it right, nothing is recorded, because no card was posed. That is by design today, the same as worked-example steps. Whether such answers should count belongs to the understanding phase.
